install-sourcegraph-instructions: <0>Install Sourcegraph</0> ( <1>visit our docs for instructions</1> ).Skip this step if you already have a private Sourcegraph instance.

enter-sourcegraph-url: Enter the <0>URL</0> (including the protocol) of your Sourcegraph instance (such as <1>https://sourcegraph.example.com</1>).
checkmark-input-field: Make sure a green checkmark appears in the input field.
read-sourcegraph-docs: Read the <0>Sourcegraph docs</0>  to learn more about how we respect your privacy, troubleshooting and extension features.
